content_of_post_to_answer: What mindset helped you become more confident?
answer: The mindset that changed confidence for me was realizing confidence is not a feeling you wait for; it is evidence you collect. Many people try to become confident before taking action, but confidence usually arrives afterward, built from keeping promises to yourself and surviving moments where you felt uncertain. The deeper shift is moving from “How do I avoid looking foolish?” to “Can I handle whatever happens?” Confidence is not believing you will always succeed; it is trusting yourself to respond when you don't.
